description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for handling 'returns' in an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages listing returns, viewing return details, adding new returns, and tracking return history, including interaction with models, views, and request/response handling.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer product returns, including listing, detail view, creation, and history tracking in an OpenCart environment.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of returns for the logged-in user, with pagination and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific return, including status, comments, and history.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Displays the form to submit a new product return, pre-filling data when available.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the submission of a new return, validating input and creating a record.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Displays a success page after successfully submitting a return.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Shows the history of status changes for a specific return.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves formatted HTML content listing the history entries for a specific return, with pagination.
